name: Simvito eSIM
description: Find and compare travel eSIM data plans by destination and trip length, see the local 4G/5G networks each plan uses, check if a phone supports eSIM, and get a link to pay on simvito.com.
author: Simvito Limited

localizations.name: Simvito eSIM
localizations.description: 按目的地和行程天数查找、比较出国旅行 eSIM 流量套餐，看每个套餐用的当地 4G/5G 网络，查手机是否支持 eSIM，并给出在 simvito.com 付款的链接。

tools.name: find_destination
tools.title: Find a destination
tools.description: Find where a trip goes: a country, a region such as 'Europe' or 'Asia', or a multi-country plan, by name in any language, ISO code or misspelling (many cities and islands such as 'Tokyo' or 'Bali' work too). Returns destination slugs for the other tools; no prices.

query.description: Country, territory or region name, e.g. 'Japan', '日本', 'JP', 'Europe'

locale.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.title: Search eSIM plans
tools.description: Find travel eSIM data plans for one destination and trip length, e.g. 'eSIM for Japan, 7 days' or '10 GB for Thailand'. Up to 5 plans with price in the user's currency, data, validity, the local operators each plan uses with 4G/5G, what happens when the data runs out, hotspot and top-up support, and a link to each plan.

destination.description: Destination slug from find_destination (e.g. 'japan', 'europe-33'), an ISO country code, or a country name in any language.

data_gb.description: Total data needed for the whole trip in GB; omit if unsure

plan_type.description: total = one data allowance for the trip; daily = allowance renews each day; unlimited. Defaults to any.

currency.description: The user's currency (ISO 4217) for prices: USD, EUR, GBP, HKD, CNY, SGD, JPY, AUD, NZD, CAD, BRL, IDR, MYR, PHP, THB, KRW, PLN, CHF, SEK, TWD, VND, TRY, SAR, AED, ILS. Defaults to USD.

locale.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: compare_networks
tools.title: Compare networks
tools.description: Compare the local mobile networks for a destination side by side, for questions like 'which network is best in Thailand' or 'which eSIM has 5G in Tokyo': each operator the plans use, its best generation (4G/5G), how many plans use it and the cheapest one. For a multi-country plan, pass country to see that country's operators.

destination.description: Destination slug from find_destination (e.g. 'japan', 'europe-33'), an ISO country code, or a country name in any language.

country.description: Only for multi-country destinations: one covered country (name or ISO code)

currency.description: The user's currency (ISO 4217) for prices: USD, EUR, GBP, HKD, CNY, SGD, JPY, AUD, NZD, CAD, BRL, IDR, MYR, PHP, THB, KRW, PLN, CHF, SEK, TWD, VND, TRY, SAR, AED, ILS. Defaults to USD.

locale.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.title: Plan a multi-country trip
tools.description: For a trip through several countries (e.g. Japan 7 days, then Korea 5 days), compare one regional plan that covers every stop with a separate plan for each country, using the cheapest plans that cover each stop's days at the daily data need.

data_gb_per_day.description: Expected data use per day in GB; defaults to 1

currency.description: The user's currency (ISO 4217) for prices: USD, EUR, GBP, HKD, CNY, SGD, JPY, AUD, NZD, CAD, BRL, IDR, MYR, PHP, THB, KRW, PLN, CHF, SEK, TWD, VND, TRY, SAR, AED, ILS. Defaults to USD.

locale.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: check_device
tools.title: Check phone eSIM support
tools.description: Check whether a phone supports eSIM, e.g. 'does my iPhone 13 support eSIM?'. Covers iPhone, Google Pixel and Samsung Galaxy from the manufacturers' official lists, including the exceptions for phones bought in mainland China, Hong Kong or Macao. Gives a verdict (supports_esim / no_esim); pass purchase_region when the user says where the phone was bought.

purchase_region.description: ISO code of the country/region where the phone was bought, e.g. 'CN', 'HK', 'US'

locale.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: get_buy_link
tools.title: Get a purchase link
tools.description: Get the simvito.com checkout link for a plan from search_plans or plan_trip, with the price in the user's currency (total for the quantity) and the payment methods for that currency. The user signs in and pays on simvito.com; nothing is charged here.

destination.description: Destination slug from find_destination (e.g. 'japan', 'europe-33'), an ISO country code, or a country name in any language.

plan_id.description: plan_id returned by search_plans or plan_trip

trip_days.description: Trip length in days, if known

quantity.description: Number of eSIMs (one per traveller). Defaults to 1.

currency.description: The user's currency (ISO 4217) for prices: USD, EUR, GBP, HKD, CNY, SGD, JPY, AUD, NZD, CAD, BRL, IDR, MYR, PHP, THB, KRW, PLN, CHF, SEK, TWD, VND, TRY, SAR, AED, ILS. Defaults to USD.

locale.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: list_my_esims
tools.title: List my eSIMs
tools.description: List the eSIMs in the user's connected Simvito account: destination, plan, status, whether installed, data left and expiry, with a link to manage each one (install, add data) on simvito.com. Requires connecting a Simvito account. Never returns installation codes.

locale.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: get_checkout_options
tools.title: Checkout options: languages, currencies, payment methods
tools.description: Languages, currencies and payment methods at simvito.com checkout. Pass the buyer's country or currency to get the default currency there and the payment methods that currency can be paid with (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, local wallets and bank payments).

country.description: Buyer's country or region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. 'JP', 'DE')

currency.description: The user's currency (ISO 4217) for prices: USD, EUR, GBP, HKD, CNY, SGD, JPY, AUD, NZD, CAD, BRL, IDR, MYR, PHP, THB, KRW, PLN, CHF, SEK, TWD, VND, TRY, SAR, AED, ILS. Defaults to USD.

language.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.

annotations.title: Checkout options: languages, currencies, payment methods

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.title: Get payment links
tools.description: When the user decides to buy and their Simvito account is connected: places the order on their account and returns two payment links to give them exactly as returned, a secure payment page for cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and local wallets, and PayPal (when available for this order), with the total, any discount and an order number. Nothing is charged until the user pays on one of those pages. Pass items for up to 5 different plans from search_plans or plan_trip (up to 10 eSIMs in all), or plan_id and quantity for one plan. If the account isn't connected, use get_buy_link instead.

destination.description: The destination search_plans returned with the plan(s); can also be given on each item.

items.description: The plans to buy, each with its quantity.

plan_id.description: plan_id returned by search_plans or plan_trip

quantity.description: Number of eSIMs of this plan (one per traveller). Defaults to 1.

destination.description: The destination search_plans returned with this plan, if it differs from the top-level destination

expected_unit_amount.description: Only after price_changed: the new unit price of this plan the user accepted. Otherwise omit.

plan_id.description: Shorthand for a single plan: plan_id returned by search_plans or plan_trip (instead of items)

quantity.description: With plan_id: number of eSIMs (one per traveller). Defaults to 1.

expected_unit_amount.description: With plan_id, only after price_changed: the new unit price the user accepted. Otherwise omit; the quoted price is used.

currency.description: The user's currency (ISO 4217) for prices: USD, EUR, GBP, HKD, CNY, SGD, JPY, AUD, NZD, CAD, BRL, IDR, MYR, PHP, THB, KRW, PLN, CHF, SEK, TWD, VND, TRY, SAR, AED, ILS. Defaults to USD.

locale.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.

device.description: Where the user will open the payment link, if you know: 'phone' or 'computer'

confirmations.description: Codes from a previous confirmation_required result that the user explicitly agreed to after seeing each text. Never fill these in for the user.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.title: Check an order
tools.description: After the user pays through start_checkout's links (e.g. they say 'paid' or 'is my eSIM ready?'): shows whether the payment arrived and the eSIM is ready, waiting up to about 25 seconds for it, with the eSIM, a link to install and manage it, and the Simvito app. Never returns installation codes.

locale.description: Language of the conversation, as a simvito.com language code ('en', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'es'…); names and links follow it. Defaults to 'en'.
